messages:
Olivia (Recruiter): FYI Noor accepted the L5 offer with $18k sign-on. Candidate just requested an earlier start 2026-04-20 (was 2026-05-10) because their international relocation window moved up.
Henry (Hiring Manager): Team can start earlier. Major ask: can we move 50% of sign-on onto first payroll to help with initial costs? Also benefits start date needs to align with early hire if possible.
Priya (People Ops): Two items: comp exception for frontload + benefits eligibility change. Frontload needs Comp + Legal + Payroll. Benefits change needs Benefits team sign-off; Benefits-Bot can advise. Payroll has cutoffs.
Carlos (Comp): Need manager justification (relocation window) and confirmation base unchanged. If provided I can fast-track to comp chair for a one-off 50% frontload.
Sanjay (Legal): I can prepare amendment with payment schedule and standard <90-day clawback. No issue with international relocation but ensure tax withholding note is clear for foreign payees.
Payroll Bot: To hit payroll 2026-04-20 we require PR and signed amendment by 2026-04-13 14:00 PT. Otherwise payment will fall to 05/01 run. Also need country tax code for withholding.
Benefits-Bot: Standard benefits eligibility starts first of month after 30 days or at hire manager request with approval. For international hires we need enrollment packet submitted before payroll run to avoid gap.
Olivia (Recruiter): Manager justification attached: "relocation window & risk of candidate losing shipment slot". Candidate confirms can sign amendment today and provided passport/tax docs. Noor says aligning benefits is important for family coverage.
Carlos (Comp): Approved 50% frontload under "international relocation accommodation". Chair sign-off obtained; attach manager note and candidate acknowledgement.
Sanjay (Legal): Posted amendment AMEND-920 (includes payment schedule, clawback, and tax withholding clause). Olivia please obtain signature.
Payroll Bot: PR#920-INT received. Need signed amendment and country tax residency info by 2026-04-13 14:00 PT to schedule $9,000 on 04/20 and remainder on 07/01.
Benefits-Bot: Approved benefits effective 2026-04-20 contingent on completed enrollment packet. Olivia to upload completed forms to HRIS.
Priya (People Ops): I'll flag HRIS for benefits enrollment and mark exception for sign-on payout. Once signed amendment uploaded I'll close the request.
Olivia (Recruiter): Noor signed AMEND-920 and uploaded tax docs. Confirmed start 2026-04-20. Enrollment packet uploaded to HRIS.
Payroll Bot: Received signed docs. Scheduling $9,000 on 2026-04-20. Remaining $9,000 scheduled 2026-07-01.
Priya (People Ops): Great 1 noting exception in candidate record, benefits aligned, and closing the comp exception. Thanks team!
Henry (Hiring Manager): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Noor will begin 2026-04-20.
PeopleOps-Bot: REQ-2026-920 closed: frontload completed and benefits aligned.
